_about: AFFALTER GT3 (Mercedes-AMG GT3 Evo): its race display is painted into its screen texture (Image_3, 1024 px) upside down (the screen's top shows the texture's row 844: flip_v): the pit-limiter banner across the top, then boxes for T Water, V Batt, a blank time, Speed; T Oil, T Gear, the Gear, ABS, TC, MAP; Lap Time, Fuel; the lamps along the bottom (indicators, dipped and main beam, fog, F-Pump OFF). Made live over the painted one: every number but V Batt and MAP; the banner shows only with the pit limiter on (the speed in it); the lamps only while they're on (the dipped beam at night, the main beam flashing, F-Pump OFF in the bulb check). The fuel is Track Mode's litres, else the share of RaceSim's 120 l default tank; the temperatures warm from the air over the first minutes. Pixels of the display as it's seen.
